stem:
Falguni sketches the Orion pattern she saw from her terrace in Nagpur. She joins several bright stars with pencil lines so her classmates can recognize the shape.

What do those pencil lines stand for?

options.text: Paths the stars travel across the sky that night
Real glowing threads stretched between the stars
Imaginary guides drawn only to help identify the star pattern
Beams of light bouncing from one star to another

teacher.key_rationale: Constellation drawings use imaginary connecting lines as identification aids; the lines are not physical objects in the sky.
